note: Changes to the published method, in order. Tests check that the published method with these applied is what the code runs. Each is explained in CHANGES.md.

H1.name: Topic clarity in the first spoken sentence
anchors: the topic is unclear after the first spoken sentence
the first spoken sentence names the topic but vaguely
the first spoken sentence gives a concrete topic and outcome, with one reading

H5.name: Hook on mute
anchors: no text on screen in the opening (an overlay, or readable words on a prop or sign the script shows), or text that makes no sense without sound
opening text on screen that is long, busy or gives the answer away
opening text on screen of 7 words or fewer that makes sense on mute and holds back the answer

scoring.4: If the judges' truth score (S9), after each judge's strictness is removed, is under 0.5 of 2, the script score is capped at 40.
